conventions.body_raw / headers: optional scenario fields (lane S2's runner): send body_raw verbatim instead of the JSON of request; headers override the runner's defaults (null removes one); the method is the route's

conventions.timing_class: fast (< ~5 s), slow, long (> 100 s: direct-local only)
conventions.truth.flank: record bases around the window, starting at truth.flank_start (0-based); clipped at the record's ends and at the fetched region's ends
conventions.truth.start: 0-based position of the window's first base on the record's forward strand (whole-record coordinates)
conventions.truth.window: the record's bases on its forward strand (for a '-' source the reverse complement of the pattern)
